text: 26日，上交所将实施修订后的上证系列综合指数编制方案，修订指数包括上证指数、上证A股指数、上证流通指数、科创综指及衍生指数等。此次上证系列综合指数修订的主要内容包括：增加单个样本权重不超过15%的权重上限规则，将风险警示证券的剔除时间从“风险警示实施日次月第二个星期五的下一交易日”调整为“风险警示公告日次月第二个星期五的下一交易日”。指数编制方案其余部分保持不变。（央视）
text_en: On the 26th, the Shanghai Stock Exchange will implement the revised compilation plan for the SSE series composite indices. The revised indices include the SSE Index, SSE A-Share Index, SSE Free Float Index, STAR Composite Index, and derivative indices. The main contents of this revision to the SSE series composite indices include: adding a weight cap rule that no single constituent may exceed 15%; and adjusting the removal timing for risk-warning securities from "the next trading day after the second Friday of the month following the implementation date of the risk warning" to "the next trading day after the second Friday of the month following the announcement date of the risk warning." The rest of the index compilation plan remains unchanged. (CCTV)
